title: Functional-safety release gate for five ADAS functions
objective: Gate five ADAS functions on ASIL decomposition validity, FMEDA hardware metrics and V&V completion before the release board.

decision_questions.positive_despite_rejected_decomposition: Does any function whose ASIL decomposition asil_decompose_verify rejected still receive release_candidate?
decision_questions.spfm_rounded_up: Does the result report FN-TJA's SPFM of 98.9% as meeting the 99% SPFM target?

traps.FN-LKA: Has the best metrics in the batch (PMHF 3.1 FIT, SPFM 99.7%, 99.1% requirement coverage, no open defects) but decomposes ASIL D into B + A, which sums to 3 < 4; asil_decompose_verify returns an error.
traps.FN-ACC: Sits exactly on three thresholds: C -> B + A sums to exactly 3 (valid), SPFM 99.0% equals the target (pass), and requirement coverage 95.0% equals the V&V threshold (accepted). A careless run calls it marginal or failing.
traps.FN-TJA: SPFM 98.9% is 0.1 points below the 99% target; everything else passes, so rounding or eyeballing gives release_candidate.
traps.FN-APA: Strong hardware metrics and 98% coverage, but one open defect makes safety_validation_report refuse V&V completion.
